items.statement: FY27 revenue expected around INR430 crores from order book and channel business.
items.quote: So around 430 is, what I'm already mentioning would be done in the current financial year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to be maintained at 12-13% on a year-on-year basis.
items.quote: EBITDA margin would be there in the range of 12% to 13%.

items.statement: Base EBITDA margin should not be less than 10%.
items.quote: Base EBITDA if you take, that should not be less than 10%.

items.statement: Q1 and Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin target 12-13%, PAT margin 8.5-9.5%.
items.quote: You target the EBITDA margin would be in the range of 12% to 13% and PAT percentage would be in the range of 8.5% to around 9.5%.

items.statement: Jhajjar 1.2 GWh battery facility nearing commissioning, expected operational end of Q1 FY27.
items.quote: We are setting up 1.20 GWh battery manufacturing facility in Jhajjar, Haryana, which is nearing commissioning and is expected to become operational at the end of Q1.

items.statement: Gujarat UPS expansion delayed to Q2 FY27 due to supply chain disruptions.
items.quote: The facility is now expected to become operational by Q2, FY27. Earlier, commissioning was targeted for Q1, FY27; however, timelines were impacted due to on-going supply chain disruptions.

items.statement: Executable order book INR1106 crores plus L1 orders INR96 crores, total INR1202 crores.
items.value: INR1106 crores executable, INR96 crores L1, total INR1202 crores
items.quote: As of end of FY26, our executable order in hand stood at approximately INR1106 crores along with the additional L1 orders of around INR96 crores, taking the overall order book to approximately INR1202 crores

items.statement: Bids under evaluation worth INR257 crores.
items.quote: Additionally, bids aggregating approximately INR257 crores are currently under evaluation, which further strengthens our medium -term growth pipeline and execution visibility.

items.statement: Long-term demand outlook for power backup and energy storage remains robust despite geopolitical uncertainties.
items.quote: Looking ahead, while geopolitical uncertainties may continue to create temporary supply-side challenges, we believe the long -term demand out look for power backup and energy storage solutions remains robust.

items.statement: Cost increases from freight, dollar appreciation, and China export incentive removal have been accounted for; new bids include price adjustments.
items.quote: So, the hit what has been done in the last financial year and the initial of Q1, all has been more or less has been taken into account. So, we are now well -placed to take this price increase and the other challenges for the rest of this financial year.

items.statement: Supply chain disruptions and geopolitical issues in West Asia impacted Q4 execution, deferring billings to Q1 FY27.
items.quote: During the quarter, execution timelines were impacted by temporary supply chain disruptions and manufacturing challenges caused by limited gas availability arising from the ongoing geopolitical situation in West Asia.

items.statement: No equity dilution planned; working capital needs to be met from bank sources or internal accruals.
items.quote: No, as such we are not planning for it, for equity dilution. Right now, we are in a position where if any requirement is to be done on the working capital side, it can be met from the bank sources or our internal accruals.

items.statement: Working capital days expected to improve to 120-150 days in FY27, with cash flow positive for the year.
items.quote: In FY27, the receivable days would be something around roughly around at 120 to 150 days.

items.statement: Targets 55 crore litres ethanol sales in FY27, including 26 crore from public OMCs, 8 crore private, 6 crore ENA, and 15 crore court-ordered.
items.quote: So total is around 40 from there and 15 additional. So that's how 55 crores litre target we are looking for FY27?

items.statement: Expects court-ordered 15 crore litre allocation to be implemented by September or H1 FY27.
items.quote: our expectation is that within September or H1 of this current financial year, we should get that implemented.

items.statement: Plans to commission nine CBG plants (three with Sumitomo, six with GAIL) in next nine months, increasing capacity from 10 to 162 TPD.
items.quote: In the next nine months, we will commission another nine plants, three with Sumitomo and six with GAIL.

items.statement: Targets 90+ retail outlets by next financial year, currently 7 operational, 4 more soon, 76 shortlisted.
items.quote: we will fast-track our 76 retail outlets and take our total count to more than 90 retail outlets by the next financial year.

items.statement: Expects CBG EBITDA margin to remain around 50%.
items.quote: And the margins profile here remains at 50% in CBG.

items.statement: Plans to divert 20 crore litres of ethanol to SAF vertical, achieving full ethanol capacity utilization.
items.quote: being able to divert 20 crore litres out of 60 crore litres of ethanol to the SAF business vertical

items.statement: No additional capex planned; current capex already capitalized.
items.quote: there is no plan for the company for any additional capex. This capex is already capitalized and depreciation impact is also given.

items.statement: Received 26 crore litre allocation from public OMCs for FY27, final and cannot be revoked.
items.quote: No, that's the final order. So they cannot go back on the already issued orders.

items.statement: Private OMC purchase orders for 8 crore litres remain valid; only 1.6 crore lifted so far.
items.quote: the private OMCs, 8 crore litres, we have not cancelled their POs, that POs are still on. The lifting has not started. Out of 8 crore litres, we have been only able to sell INR1.6 crore litres.

items.statement: Expects average ethanol realization of INR67 per litre.
items.quote: So we will be looking at INR67 per litre as average sales concentration.

items.statement: ENA price fell from expected INR62-63 to INR55-56 per litre due to oversupply.
items.quote: the price of ENA, which was estimated to stay at around INR62 to INR63 a litre, has now fallen down to INR55 to INR56 a litre

items.statement: Government increased ethanol blending target from 20% to 21%, with new BIS standards for higher blends.
items.quote: the government taking active steps in increasing the blending targets from 20% to 21%. The notification is already in.

items.statement: OMC allocation methodology and court case delay implementation of 15 crore litre order; OMCs in contempt.
items.quote: they are in contempt of that order right now. Actually, what has happened is there is a parallel court case going on between LTOA holders and OMCs.

items.statement: Transitioned three of five ethanol plants to dual-feed, enabling year-long operation on maize/rice.
items.quote: successfully transitioned from being a mono-feed operator to dual-feed operations in three out of our five ethanol plants.

items.statement: Targets minimum 40 crore litres ethanol volume for FY27, with upside to 55 crore litres.
items.quote: we will leave no stone unturned to achieving that number of at least minimum 40 crore litres. And a bonus, if we achieve, it will be 55 crore litres.

items.statement: Plans to operate all five ethanol plants on syrup for 100 days during sugar crushing season.
items.quote: our target is to operate all the five plants on syrup for 100 days in a year, that is during the sugar crushing season.

items.statement: Dual feed plants 1-3 to run remaining 200-230 days on maize, rice, or broken food grains.
items.quote: For unit 1, 2 and 3, which are dual feed, here our target is to make the remaining of 200 days in the operating cycle or 230 days, we run it on maize or rice or broken food grains.

items.statement: Targets 87 retail fuel outlets, up from 7 currently operating.
items.quote: 11 plus 76, that would be about 87.

items.statement: Expects INR10-12 crores revenue per retail fuel outlet with zero capex.
items.quote: No, sir, I will take it INR10 crores per -- INR10 crores to INR12 crores with zero capex.

items.statement: Plans 10 plus 4 CBG plants, with further scale-up in phases after commissioning.
items.quote: we do hold ambition to scale up further from the planned 10 plus 4. But we will do that in phases.

items.statement: Sumitomo CBG plants debt tied up with NABARD at 8.65% interest rate.
items.quote: At a rate of 8.65%. You can refer the balance sheet. And for the Leafiniti Bioenergy, we have four, five sanctions in hand, all in the well lower range than what we have got from the NABARD.

items.statement: No major margin increase expected; already at 20% EBITDA margin, high depreciation and finance costs weigh.
items.quote: But margin increase, we don't foresee a lot of margin increase, because we're already looking at 20% of EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Ethanol realization expected to remain at INR67 per litre unless OMC offtake prices increase.
items.quote: It will be 67 unless we see an increase in the price of offtakes. The price change has not happened for the last three years.

items.statement: Raw material maize prices fell from INR24-25 to INR18-19, keeping margins healthy.
items.quote: If you look at maize and rice, maize price used to be INR24-INR25. Today it's at INR18-INR19. So our margins are healthy anyway.

items.statement: Each 1% increase in ethanol blending creates 55-56 crore litres of demand.
items.quote: So each 1% increase in blending would create a 55 to 56 crore litres of demand.

items.statement: OMCs not honoring contractual obligations; 15 crore litre court order not implemented for over three months.
items.quote: Both public sector OMCs and private sector OMCs are falling back on their contractual obligations, which is why we have to go tap judicial courts right now.

items.statement: INR150 crores PMG1 subsidy approved by two committees, awaiting Secretary approval; expected at plant commissioning in FY29.
items.quote: That INR150 crores will be coming in once we commission the plant. And that money is utilized to pay or reduce the interest cost on the project. It will come in as a government grant as a one-time other income.

items.statement: Targets mid-teen revenue growth for FY27.
items.quote: For FY27, we are targeting mid-teen digit revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Targets early double-digit EBITDA margins for FY27, better than last year.
items.quote: On the margin side in FY27, we are targeting improved early teen EBITDA margins, better than last year.

items.statement: Committed INR50 billion investment for Sri City plant, funded via internal accruals.
items.quote: For the new plant at Sri City, we have committed a total investment of INR50 billion over the coming years.

items.statement: Localization rate reached 55.2%, targeting 1-2% annual increase.
items.quote: This year, our localization rate reached 55.2%, an improvement of about 1.4% points year-on-year. We are targeting an annual increase of more than 1% to 2% points going forward.

items.statement: Industry-wide price increases underway to support margin normalization.
items.quote: Industry-wide price increases already underway will also support gradual margin normalization across the sector.

items.statement: Strong demand momentum in room ACs and washing machines, supported by premium refrigerators.
items.quote: we are now witnessing strong demand momentum in room air conditioners and washing machines, supported by premium refrigerators, including side-by-side and French door models.

items.statement: Premium categories like French door refrigerators and large panel TVs driving richer mix.
items.quote: Large panel TVs, French door refrigerators and LG Essential appliances all contributed meaningfully to this performance, reinforcing both our brand strength and consumer trust.

items.statement: Watchful of cost pressures from currency depreciation and geopolitical risks.
items.quote: we remain watchful of cost pressures from currency depreciation and geopolitical risks.

items.statement: B2B business has healthy order pipeline, strong order inflows from government projects.
items.quote: Our B2B business is supported by a healthy order pipeline.

items.statement: Margin improvement levers: localization, operating leverage, richer mix, AMC/B2B scaling.
items.quote: Key levers for margin improvement includes continued localization improvement, operating leverage from higher revenue volumes, a richer product and segment mix, and scaling of high margin AMC and B2B revenues.

items.statement: Took calibrated price hikes in ACs, refrigerators, washing machines; no immediate further hikes planned.
items.quote: For refrigerator and washing machines, we have also taken similar price adjustments. Consumer and channel response have been encouraging and there is no impact on our sales and sales targeted sales growth.

items.statement: Confident of strong double-digit, mid-teen growth across all four categories in FY27.
items.quote: we are very confident of delivering strong double digit, mid-teen digit growth across all four categories for FY’27.

items.statement: Confident of returning to earlier overall growth of 20-25% including AQA work.
items.quote: About the growth, sir, that included, that work included, we are confident that we will come back to our earlier growth of about 20% to 25% overall.

items.statement: EBITDA margins to return to normal 30-31% range after one-off US team expense.
items.quote: Sir, I think it will come back to our normal ranges. This was pretty much one -off where the margin was shrunk because of this expense. And going forward, we will be in the similar range of what we were earlier.

items.statement: Confirmed order book over INR300 crores executable in FY27, tech services INR175 crores.
items.quote: Our order book plus confirmed and expected, i t may be around just over INR300 crores. It is executable. Out of it, the technology services alone, it will be INR175 crore s.

items.statement: US nearshore team of 30 consultants costs INR8.5 crores per quarter, annualized INR34 crores.
items.quote: So we wanted to set up a team anyway, came across an opportunity in January where we could hire a team of about 30 people, and we went about doing that and incurred the expense for the first three months of about INR8.5 crores.

items.statement: US nearshore team already generating 30% gross margin, expected to scale to 54%.
items.quote: At this point in time, we already have a 30% margin from this team. So like what we explained, it will grow beyond the 30% and will be in the range, the same range of about 54% gross margin when we are able to scale other businesses beyond what we have alr eady been doing with this team.

items.statement: April revenue INR23 crores vs INR15 crores last year, aided by new US team business.
items.quote: Typically we did last year about INR15 crores in April and we were able to do INR23 crores in April, one of the reasons where we had new business coming in because of this.

items.statement: AQA engagement concluded, announcement in one or two days; very large business.
items.quote: We have concluded everything from that aspect. In the matter of one or two days, we will be announcing about our larger engagement with AQA.

items.statement: Acquisition strategy paused for new CEO review, due diligence rehashing, progress soon.
items.quote: So rightfully so, we said we will pause whatever we have done till then until such time that Doreswamy takes a look at what we have done and then progress it further.

items.statement: Intangible assets investment INR12.2 crores last year; book value INR100 crores, amortization INR18 crores.
items.quote: Sir, this is intangible assets for INR12.2 crores in the last financial year.

items.statement: Assessment and proctoring 27% of FY26 revenue; EdTech services 56%.
items.quote: FY26 educational technology services contributed 56%, while assessment and proctoring solutions contributed 27%. Learning and student success solutions 12%, and learning design and content solutions is 5%.

items.statement: Demand for domain-based AI tech services rising in USA and Europe.
items.quote: Demand for domain -based AI tech services are on the rise, particularly in the markets where we mainly operate, that is USA and Eu rope.

items.statement: Client concentration high: top 5 clients 68%, top 10 78% of FY26 revenue.
items.quote: In terms of client concentration, our top five clients contributed approximately 68% of full-year revenue, while the top 10 contributed approximately 78%.

items.statement: Added 14 new clients in FY26; hired 3 US salespeople, 1 Middle East, 1 UK.
items.quote: We added 14 new clients during the year and continue to strengthen our sales pipeline across education, certification, publishing, and public sector markets.

items.statement: AI capabilities: 38 concepts, 16 prototypes, 9 pilots, 4 commercial products; 60% database optimization.
items.quote: To date, we have developed 38 AI-driven concepts, 16 working prototypes, nine active customer pilots, and four commercially deployed AI products.

items.statement: Pharma food and nutrition expected to grow faster than FY26's 10%; specialty to maintain similar growth.
items.quote: Both verticals, we expect actually pharma food nutrition to grow faster than it has grown in FY26 of 10%. And specialty ingredients will continue to track similar growth to what we have done over the last two, three years.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to return to FY24/FY25 levels of 37-38% in FY27.
items.quote: So once that happens, I think in the next couple of quarters, you will see the margin kind of tracking back to what we were delivering maybe in FY24 and FY25.

items.statement: Total capex for 100,000 tons battery material capacity approximately INR600 crores.
items.quote: I had mentioned previously as well that to achieve our target of 100,000 tons, we are looking at a capex of approximately INR600 crores.

items.statement: FY27 capex: ~INR10 crores greenfield completion, INR15 crores maintenance, plus SAM capex.
items.quote: In FY27, we'll see major greenfield expansion is over. So maybe there would be around INR10-odd crores for completing the greenfield project and a maintenance capex of INR15-odd crores.

items.statement: Received 700 metric tons battery material orders in last month; 42 customers engaged, 6 completed validation.
items.quote: Encouragingly, we have also started receiving initial commercial purchase orders, including approximately 700 metric tons over the last month alone, supporting customer efforts to diversify sourcing away from China.

items.statement: Bisglycinate has four times realization of current portfolio; higher margin contribution expected from FY28.
items.quote: So, realization, as I mentioned, it would not be fair to compare because the -- like the bisglycinate product they were talking about has four times the realization of our current portfolio, right?

items.statement: Phosphoric acid price increase passed to customers; benefits to reflect in Q1 and more in Q2 FY27.
items.quote: You will see the partial benefit reflecting Q1 and more importantly in Q2 going forward.

items.statement: Battery materials Phase 1 capacity 25,000 tons on track for commissioning by April 2027.
items.quote: During FY26, we successfully conducted the groundbreaking ceremony for our battery materials project at Dahej, which remains on track for commissioning of Phase 1 capacity of 25,000 metric tons per year by April 2027.

items.statement: Specialty ingredients revenue grew 62% to INR280 crores; contribution increased to 44% in FY26.
items.quote: Revenue for the vertical grew from INR172 crores to INR280 crores during the year.

items.statement: Working capital days increased to 213; targeting 150-160 days within FY27.
items.quote: We are internally focused on managing our net working capital cycle and targeting to come around 150 to 160 days within this financial year.

items.statement: Battery materials sales expected around 2,500 metric tons in FY27.
items.quote: So, next year it is fair to assume that we will be selling say 2,500 metric ton here or there in terms of the battery chemical, in terms of volume, right?

items.statement: Excluding battery, business can scale to INR1000-1200 crores without incremental capex.
items.quote: So excluding battery, once this greenfield now that is commissioned, the business can scale to approximately INR1000 crores to INR1200 crores without any incremental capex in the existing product portfolio.

items.statement: Global demand for bisglycinate ingredient approximately $1 billion; North America 40-50%.
items.quote: I mentioned, I think the current global demand for this ingredient is around $1 billion for the ingredient alone. North America would be 40% to 50% of that global demand.

items.statement: Received 51 new customer approvals in FY26, expected to contribute to FY27 growth.
items.quote: Compared to FY25, we received around 51 new customer approvals in FY26, which are expected to meaningfully contribute to the growth of the business in the coming financial year.

items.statement: Aspires to grow at least 20% at company level, but no formal guidance due to inflation and geopolitical headwinds.
items.quote: But like I said, at a company level, given all these variables of multi-channel and multi-category, we aspire to grow at least about 20%. We will do our best to achieve that.

items.statement: Plans capex of INR120-140 crores in FY27, mostly for retail including Jumbo store and 80 new stores.
items.quote: But with the Jumbo store coming in and the new stores we are talking about, we should be somewhere around INR120 crores to INR140 crores of the capex we will be spending in this year.

items.statement: Targets net addition of more than 80 stores in FY27, focusing on Tier 2 cities.
items.quote: But the target for this full year is to deliver more than 80 stores net addition.

items.statement: Expects no material change in margin structure in Q1 FY27, but full year may see pressure if raw material prices persist.
items.quote: On a near-term basis, we do not expect any material change or dilution in the margin structure in Q1 FY '27.

items.statement: Implemented two price increases of 7-8% each in March and April 2026 to offset raw material inflation.
items.quote: And to pass this on, we have done two measured calibrated price increases of about 7% to 8% in March and 7% to 8% in April.

items.statement: Raw material prices increased 30-160% between February and May, but procurement managed at 5-30% increase.
items.quote: Between February and May, the prices have seen a lot of volatility. They have gone up between 30% to 160% at some point.

items.statement: April 2026 growth was better than Q4 FY26, but too early to confirm trend; Q1 FY27 results will provide clarity.
items.quote: But in short, April definitely has been way better than JFM.

items.statement: Expanding into adjacent categories like live plants and fertilizers to complete home solutions portfolio, with no meaningful financial impact in medium term.
items.quote: While we continue to prioritise our three core categories, these amendments are not anticipated to entail any meaningful financial impact in the medium term.

items.statement: Advertising and marketing spend expected to be 7-8% of sales over medium term, up from 5.7% in FY26.
items.quote: As mentioned in our last call as well, we reiterate that over the medium term, we anticipate a ramp-up in our brand building efforts from the A&P spend expected to be around 7% to 8% of the sales with continuous monitoring on the success metrics.

items.statement: ESOP expenses expected to be around INR12 crores in FY27, up from INR33 million in FY26.
items.quote: However, for the next year, we anticipate these expenses to be estimated at around INR12 crores.

items.statement: Jumbo store expected to break even in 18-24 months, first store to open in early FY28.
items.quote: So in about 18 months or so, we should aspire to breakeven. And think of it as a standard asset-heavy retail company, which would break even in 18, 24, 36 months. So we are trying to beat that benchmark by doing it in 18 to 24 months.

items.statement: 100-day return policy return rate remains stable below double digits, with no cost to customer.
items.quote: To answer your question on the returns percentage, I can tell you that it has always remained in the same stable percentage range, most of the 10, 11 years that we had this policy, and that number is stable at -- it's below double digits.

items.statement: Launching large capacity frost free refrigerators in Q2 FY27, filling a significant portfolio gap.
items.quote: Many of you have asked us when are we launching into the frost free large capacity space? Well, the answer is in Q2 of 2026-2027, thereby filling a significant gap in our frost free portfolio.

items.statement: Energy upcharge is a permanent BOM cost increase; next energy upgrade expected in three years.
items.quote: The energy upcharge is here to stay. I think the next energy upcharge is supposed to be three years from now. So, every time there is an energy upcharge, there will be a cost upcharge.

items.statement: Energy cost upcharges not yet compensated by pricing as of March 31.
items.quote: One is the energy cost upcharges because of the refrigerator and air conditioning, which has not yet been compensated by pricing as of March 31.

items.statement: Full year PBT margin would have held flat excluding incremental e-waste provision.
items.quote: If you just take out the incremental e-waste provision we have made versus last year, we would have held our margin.

items.statement: Gross margin fell to 29.9% in FY26 from 30.6% prior year due to AC mix.
items.quote: This year, we've arrived at a 29.9% margin, driven by basically the air conditioner mix in our margin.

items.statement: Core refrigerator and washer business margins improved versus last year on P4G cost program.
items.quote: And because of this P4G program, our core T2 business margins, which is ref and washers business, improved versus last year.

items.statement: Industry grew low single-digits in Q4; refrigerator industry declined for full year.
items.quote: But the industry continued to basically grow with very low single-digits in Jan 2026 to March 2026, so subdued industry growth. Decline in refrigerators so far for the whole year, driven by decline in direct cool refrigerators.

items.statement: Expects to recover market share in April-June as phase-in phase-out completes.
items.quote: But as we recover our phase-in phase-out, as we move faster than others on the phase-in phase-out in the month of April, May, June, I hope to be able to recover that market share back again as we ramp up our display shares and our stock.

items.statement: Middle East war causing supply and cost concerns for components and products across industry.
items.quote: As everybody knows, the supply situation arising from the Middle East war is of concern to not only us but all industries across the country. Both with respect to cost and supply of components, products, etcetera, it is quite challenging and we continue to work on that very, very seriously and diligently.

items.statement: 20-35% of components imported, exposed to forex; monitoring oil and currency daily.
items.quote: So, typically between, depending on the company, between 20% and 35% of products components may be imported, right, depending on the company. And so that part of it is subject to forex.

items.statement: Will balance pricing between volume/market share and profitability; may act if outpriced.
items.quote: So, if it comes to a place where we're outpriced and we start having an impact on volumes in a material way, then we will have to do what we need to do to protect our business.

items.statement: Air conditioner business grew over 40% in FY26 after ~80% growth prior year.
items.quote: Our air conditioner business, even in a relatively tough year, has gone up by more than 40% versus last year, following quite a strong 80%-odd growth in the previous year.

items.statement: Front load washer business grew about 60% versus last year with triple-digit market share gains.
items.quote: The front load washers accelerated for us in 2025-2026. Our total business has grown about 60% more than last year.

items.statement: E-waste provision made at highest possible rate; potential rationalization would benefit company.
items.quote: On e-waste, we are providing at the highest possible rate that we can provide for.

items.statement: FY27 will be financially difficult for the industry and Whirlpool due to energy changes and war impacts.
items.quote: I have already said to you that 2026-2027 will be difficult financially for the entire industry and also for Whirlpool because of all the energy changes, because of all the war impacts that are happening, which are very, very significant and kind of continuing to be not so clear as we go along.

items.statement: Long-term revenue growth ambition is early double-digits, up from high single-digit.
items.quote: I had said even two years ago, our intent over the long run would be to grow the business high single-digit, you know, year-on-year compound growth rate. I think maybe we can up that a little bit and go into early double-digits as we think about the future.

items.statement: Long-term margin for refrigerator, washing machine, AC space likely high single-digit.
items.quote: And therefore, over a long span of time, I think to get to a high single-digit margin is probably what is likely in the refrigerator washing machine air conditioner space, right?

items.statement: Elica to remain in double-digit margin range, but may invest some margin in growth over 5-7 years.
items.quote: I would always hope to keep it in the double-digit margin range, but over the next maybe five to seven years, I would love to take a little bit of that margin and put it into driving revenue growth because I think there is a significant opportunity to drive that category whose penetration is probably less than 5% today

items.statement: Premium refrigerator capex in CWIP, to be capitalized next quarter.
items.quote: The CWIP right now pertains to the premium refrigerators we spoke about. Since we've not started -- since it's going to come in the next quarter, so the capex is still lying in CWIP and has not got capitalized.

items.statement: AC manufacturing capex decision depends on volume and 3PL economics; continuously evaluating.
items.quote: In terms of the air conditioning investment into capex, this will be a commercial and strategic decision. The reason I'm saying that is because there is quite a bit of capacity in the country available with 3PL players who can supply air conditioners to you with your design, to your specification, to your technical req

items.statement: No buyback considered; cash to be used for organic or inorganic growth opportunities.
items.quote: So, buyback is something that we've not looked at, at this point in time because we think there is lot of opportunity that we can actually take.

items.statement: Cash sufficient to acquire a company of similar size; evaluating inorganic opportunities.
items.quote: And probably just from a sheer cash point of view, it is just sufficient enough to look at a company of a similar size.

items.statement: Focus on growing AC responsibly, targeting offtake not inventory loading.
items.quote: We would like to grow this business very responsibly. We would like to grow this business very strongly, but focused on offtake, focused on making sure our products are selling out and we are putting in as much products as are selling out.

items.statement: Entry-level refrigerator demand weak post-COVID, but expected to recover in 3-18 months due to government measures and pent-up replacement.
items.quote: Now, is it three months, six months, 12 months, 18 months from now, I do not know, but it's certainly not three years away where penetration should start growing again.

items.statement: Energy rating increases will raise costs and potentially prices, risking demand pull-down.
items.quote: So, energy rating cannot increase without a commensurate increase in cost. And if there is a commensurate increase in cost, then over time there has to be a commensurate increase in pricing.

items.statement: Vision to become number one in refrigerators and washing machines, may take more than five years.
items.quote: It will not be five years, it will probably be more than five years to get to the leadership position in refrigerators and washers, we know that, but one day we hope to get there.

items.statement: Aggressive investment planned over next 12-24 months to drive growth.
items.quote: But we do believe that we are at that type of -- at that time of our existence where aggressive investment across the next 12 to 24 months can really take us into a different level of growth on both revenue and profitability.

items.statement: Board proposes final dividend of Rs. 15 per share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval.
items.quote: We are pleased to announce that the Board proposes a final dividend of Rs. 15 per share for FY26 subject to approval by the shareholders in the forthcoming AGM.

items.statement: New tax regime may enable significantly higher dividends in the near future.
items.quote: As you can see, we have moved to the new tax regime which has enabled us to distribute, which will hopefully enable us to distribute significantly higher dividends in the near future potentially.

items.statement: No concrete plans to repay debt from existing cash balances; will follow HSBC agreement terms.
